# BeFunky

> BeFunky is a free online photo editor and graphic design platform offering AI-powered image editing, collage creation, and design tools for creators of all skill levels.

BeFunky provides an integrated suite of creative tools including a photo editor with AI enhancements, collage maker, graphic designer, and specialized features like background removal and photo-to-art conversion. The platform serves both casual users and designers looking for accessible, browser-based creative solutions.

## Core Creative Tools

- [Photo Editor](https://www.befunky.com/create): BeFunky Photo Editor with AI-powered image enhancement and retouching tools
- [Collage Maker](https://www.befunky.com/create/collage): BeFunky Collage Maker for creating customizable photo collages with templates
- [Graphic Designer](https://www.befunky.com/create/designer): BeFunky Graphic Designer tool with templates for social media and marketing
- [Homepage](https://www.befunky.com): BeFunky homepage showcasing photo editor, collage maker, and AI-powered editing tools
- [Dashboard](https://www.befunky.com/dashboard): BeFunky dashboard providing overview of photo editing and graphic design tools

## AI-Powered Features

- [Background Remover](https://www.befunky.com/features/background-remover): BeFunky AI Background Remover for transparent backgrounds and replacements
- [Photo Retouching](https://www.befunky.com/features/touch-up): BeFunky AI portrait enhancer for photo retouching and skin smoothing
- [Photo to Art](https://www.befunky.com/features/photo-to-art): BeFunky Photo to Art feature with Cartoonizer and artistic effect filters
- [Batch Photo Editor](https://www.befunky.com/features/batch-photo-editor): BeFunky Batch Photo Editor for bulk image editing and batch processing
